text: 1. Applicants must have a good command of English. All the courses are taught in English. Applicants’ mother tongue or second language must be English, or they should have learned courses in English. They should be skillful in English listening, speaking, reading and writing.2. Applicants must be high school graduates. They must have passed English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology graduation exams. Their physics, chemistry and biology exam results must be above average.3. Applicants can’t have any adverse record. Applicants must submit their graduation certificate, exam result sheet, passport and identity card. Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years old. Applicants under 18 must submit letter of authorization for guardianship.4. Applicants must be healthy and have passed health check-up.5. Applicants must have sufficient financial support for all the fees of MBBS major.
